title: Kevin Weil Launches Warp Sciences With $215M to Automate Drug Labs
summary:
A newly formed venture is seeking to bring pharmaceutical research back to the US by replacing manual processing with robotic systems. Warp Sciences has raised a $215M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners to build fully robotic laboratories that accelerate the discovery of medicines and reduce the reliance of drug companies on overseas providers in China.

Kevin Weil, the former head of AI-for-science at OpenAI, co-founded the startup with DJ Patil, FAIR co-founder Manohar Paluri, and Sol Reisberg. The venture aims to transition frontier AI from software interfaces into physical laboratories and has recruited specialized personnel, including B.K. Spears, who contributed to achieving Q>1 fusion at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory.

💥 Introducing Warp Sciences, a new company applying AI and robotics to help the world develop new medicines faster.
